about: The heading of a Gospel reading from Saint John. Sequéntia means the continuation: the passage is read from the course of the Gospel, not from its opening verses. The 1962 Roman Missal prints it over the Gospels of Low Sunday, of Pentecost Sunday, of the feast of the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus and of the three Masses of the Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed, among many other Masses.

seg.tr: The continuation of the holy Gospel according to John
